# buddha.md AI access

This site provides Buddhist source texts and lecture transcripts for human reading and AI-agent workflows.

Machine-readable entry points:
- Main manifest: https://buddha.md/manifest.json
- Tangjin manifest: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jackylee0424/buddha-md/main/public/materials/tangjin/manifest.json
- Diamond Sutra lecture manifest: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jackylee0424/buddha-md/main/public/materials/diamond/manifest.json
- Minimal CLI: https://buddha.md/cli

Install the inspectable CLI:
curl -fsSL https://buddha.md/cli -o buddha-md
chmod +x buddha-md

Learn the commands from built-in help:
./buddha-md --help
./buddha-md fetch --help
./buddha-md fetch tangjin --help
./buddha-md fetch diamond --help

Raw text fetches are book-level only. Use the CLI help to choose the correct command for downloading a complete corpus into local files. The CLI keeps buddha.md small by downloading raw text files from this public repository snapshot.

Download the Tangjin JSONL bundle if needed:
./buddha-md bundle tangjin --out ./buddha-materials/tangjin-transcripts.jsonl

Recommended AI-agent workflow:
1. Download the CLI from https://buddha.md/cli.
2. Run `chmod +x buddha-md`.
3. Run `./buddha-md --help`, then command-level help such as `./buddha-md fetch --help`.
4. Fetch one complete raw-text book corpus into a local folder.
5. Use local transcript files as the source of truth.
6. Cite the local filename and lecture number when answering.
7. Prefer raw text endpoints over scraping the visual React site.

CLI dependency policy:
- Single inspectable POSIX shell script.
- No Node, Python, npm, pip, package install, or third-party library dependencies.
- Uses curl only for HTTPS downloads.

Preferred citation:
buddha.md, Tangjin lecture archive for the Platform Sutra course, Li Ruilie lecture transcripts.
